Import updated Excel

Original format: Branch and F.I.. Branch code is optional: upload without it and add codes later with Edit. Separate Branch Code, Old Branch Name and Old Branch Code columns are optional. Missing rows in an uploaded file are kept.

Codes keep leading zeros as shown in Excel. A name containing a code stays intact; codes are not guessed from names. Use an old name/code column when both the branch name and code change.

Replace: choose the bank above. If a bank column is mapped, only matching rows are used. All old branches of that bank will be removed after confirmation.

Excel import → format.xlsx columns

Choose source columns, review values, then download the 13-column Sheet1.

Files are processed in your browser. Select multiple files, then map one worksheet from each file. Build each file’s preview to combine its rows. Duplicate data rows are retained; exclude unwanted rows in review. Bank/branch text is not split automatically, and geographic segments are not guessed as tehsils. Multiple names separated by / stay in one cell. Source data and preview edits are not saved after reload.

Build a preview for each file. Blank formatted rows are ignored; data up to Excel row 100,000 is supported.

In section mode: A = valuation/client/amount; B = bank/branch/tehsil/asset/commodity; C = team members. Set each section’s heading row, data range and S.No. column. Missing B/C records are flagged; duplicate S.No. or extra B/C records block the preview.
